name: Unknown
source: The owner of the house where Hime wakes up after moving to human world. His name is unknown throughout the game and Hime calls him "My Lord" since he is only one she can rely on. He treats Hime kindly and takes good care of her while tricking her into doing many lewd things in the name of trial. He is good at cooking and it's also implied that he has a lot of experiences with woman.
